title: Quality Guard: centralized eval-signal broadcast and alert dedupe for Console integrations
creator: Maya Patel
description: Problem: teams are receiving noisy, duplicated regression alerts in Slack and PagerDuty after model/config rollouts. Current eval->alert pathways are per-suite and emit separate notifications for each metric and each route, leading to multiple simultaneous pages for the same underlying quality change. Goal: build a centralized "Quality Guard" broadcast layer in Console that ingests eval signals, applies grouping/deduplication and noise filtering, and routes a single contextual alert to configured destinations (Slack channels, PagerDuty services) with clear rollback/runbook actions.
background: Multiple customers reported simultaneous alerts after a training rollback and a runtime config tweak last quarter. Engineering has a PR for better telemetry (ENG-20577), and product needs to standardize how eval signals are interpreted and surfaced. We want a coarse-to-fine model: high priority single-page for production-impacting regressions, quieter digests for low-severity or non-prod changes.
goals: Create a Quality Guard service in Console that subscribes to eval events and normalizes signals
Implement a deterministic fingerprint + temporal grouping algorithm to dedupe alerts across metrics/routes/models
Support configurable routing to Slack workspaces and PagerDuty services per-customer and per-project
Provide an in-console UI to review grouped incidents, inspect contributing evals, and link to PRs and rollouts
Deliver rollout plan that defaults to digest mode for new users and escalates to paging after opt-in/thresholds
acceptance_criteria: Grouped alert contains list of impacted routes, model versions, and delta metrics (metric, baseline, new)
Single PagerDuty incident created per fingerprint for production-impacting groups during the sticky window
Slack channel receives a compact summary with a link to Console incident thread and evaluation run details
Dedupe window and fingerprinting strategy configurable in Console (defaults described in runbook)
False-positive rate (measured by PM review feedback) does not exceed 10% in first month of opt-in rollout
implementation_notes: Signal normalization: canonical fields = eval_suite_id, model_version, config_hash, metric_name, delta, p_value, run_id
Fingerprint = sha1(model_version + ':' + config_hash + ':' + eval_suite_id + ':' + metric_name) -> string
Temporal grouping window default = 30 minutes (configurable per-customer); sticky dedupe TTL = 4 hours for production
Aggregation strategy: if multiple metrics in same fingerprint cross thresholds concurrently, surface aggregated top-3 metrics in alert
Noise filter: require consecutive failing runs N=2 for non-prod environments before paging
Routing mapping: Console maps customer->Slack workspace/channel and customer->PagerDuty service; fallthrough goes to a configured SRE service
Fallback: if PagerDuty API errors, write incident to Console incident queue and notify via Slack only
Telemetry: expose metrics for grouped_alerts_total, deduped_alerts_total, alerts_paged_total, avg_grouping_latency
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (beta): internal teams + 3 pilot customers; default to Slack digests, PagerDuty disabled
Phase 2: enable PagerDuty for opt-in customers and add sticky dedupe; collect feedback and tune thresholds
Phase 3: GA with per-project configuration, migration guide, and admin controls
Rollback plan: admins can flip a per-project toggle to disable Quality Guard and fall back to legacy per-eval alerts
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: over-aggregation hides distinct regressions —> Mitigation: include full list of contributing evals in incident and quick-expand in UI
Risk: missed pages for true production incidents due to tuning —> Mitigation: conservative defaults for prod (lower thresholds, sticky TTL), monitoring on false-negative metric
Risk: external integration failures (Slack/PagerDuty) —> Mitigation: graceful degrade to Console-only incident tracking and retries
tasks: Finalize fingerprint algorithm and edge-case handling (PM + ENG)
Ship telemetry enhancements from ENG-20577 into event stream (ENG)
Implement Quality Guard service to subscribe to eval events (ENG)
Build Console UI for grouped incidents with expand/collapse for contributing evals (DES + ENG)
Integrate Slack webhook and PagerDuty service mapping with per-customer settings (ENG)
Write runbook for SRE and on-call including ack/escalation flows (PM + SRE)
Pilot with internal teams and 3 customers, gather feedback, tune thresholds
dependencies_and_links: ENG-20577 - eval regression telemetry improvements (already referenced)
